summary: Artelo Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its At-The-Market Offering Agreement with R.F. Lafferty, effective May 18, 2026. The agreement allowed sales of up to $6.5M in common stock, with $451,527 raised from 50,858 shares. This is a routine contractual termination, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event is present. The filing is merely a current report of a definitive agreement ending, with no acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. Risk-arbitrage or special-situations angle is absent.
